text.title: WebSocket Design Procedure
text.summary: 7-step procedure applying the websocket-design methodology end-to-end. Each step lists inputs, action, output, and optional decision gate.

step.name: define-envelope
step.action: Write the shared {v, type, channel, id, seq, ts, payload} schema in Zod/Pydantic/protobuf. Bump v for breaking changes; id carries idempotency across retries, seq carries dedup across reconnects.
step.decision-gate: Reject any freeform payload that bypasses the envelope.

step.name: schema-per-message-type
step.action: Attach a JSON schema to every message type and wire validation on both the server and the client. Decide the rejection path: an error envelope for recoverable input, close code 1008 for a policy violation and 1009 for an oversize frame.
step.output: message_schemas block + the close-code table this service emits
step.decision-gate: Reject any message type shipping without a schema, and any close path that emits a bare close. Rules schema-validated-per-type + close-code-truthful.

step.name: wire-heartbeat
step.action: Add server-side ping/pong: disconnect after 2 missed pongs (≈90 s). Client pings every 25 s. Do not rely on TCP keep-alive.

step.name: implement-reconnect
step.action: Add full-jitter exponential backoff capped at 30s + maxAttempts. Reject PRs without random() in the diff.

step.name: horizontal-scale
step.action: Replace in-process fan-out with Redis Pub/Sub channel subscriptions (one channel per logical topic).

step.name: size-send-queue-and-auth
step.action: Bound the per-connection outbound queue and declare shed_policy explicitly (drop_oldest / drop_newest / close_1008). Issue the handshake credential as a single-use signed token with TTL <= 5 minutes, carried in Sec-WebSocket-Protocol where the client can set it.
step.output: send_queue block + auth block with ttl_seconds
step.decision-gate: Reject unbounded queues, queues with no named shed policy, and cookie-only auth. Rules bounded-send-queue + short-lived-token-auth.

step.name: smoke-load-test
step.action: Run k6 for 60s; assert status 101 + heartbeat success + reconnect after node restart.
step.decision-gate: Reject if reconnect storm peaks > 2x steady auth RPS.
